name: Kolors · Kolors

title.zh: Kolors · 查看基础色阶到语义角色的映射

description.zh: 看Canvas等背景角色的基础色到语义名映射，未测导出。 Kolors是Souhail Benlhachemi制作的设计系统配色工具，页面展示基础色阶及背景、边框、文字的语义token映射，并声明支持导出。此轮只核现有色阶与背景角色映射，未操作生成或导出，费用与许可仍未知。
description.en: Kolors by Souhail Benlhachemi presents base color scales and semantic mappings for design-system backgrounds, borders and text. The page advertises primitive and semantic token export. Current scales and background mappings were visually reviewed; generation, editing and export were not tested. Price, software licensing and output commercial terms remain unknown.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Kolors (https://www.kolors.dev/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Canvas等背景角色的基础色到语义名映射，未测导出。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页标题与灰阶，再下滚比较Primary蓝紫和Secondary绿色阶，当前两组的浅深编号与色值均可辨。Color Roles里可见neutral-50连到background-canvas，也有Surface和Inverse映射，适合核对设计系统命名。本次未改色、生成或导出；已核原源未给费用、软件许可及输出商用条款。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
